oneLiner: A decision log that tracks what was decided, why, and when.
problem: Teams and individuals frequently lose context around decisions made—why they were chosen, who approved them, and when. This leads to repeated debates, inconsistent choices, and wasted time re-explaining rationale.
targetUser: Product managers, engineering leads, and project coordinators who need to maintain institutional memory of decisions across their teams.
coreFlow: User creates a new decision entry with title and context
User documents the decision rationale and key factors considered
User logs the decision date and stakeholders involved
User can view all decisions in a chronological or searchable log
User can reference past decisions to understand historical context

screens.name: Decision List
screens.purpose: Display all logged decisions chronologically with filters by date, status, or topic for quick reference

screens.name: Create Decision
screens.purpose: Form to capture decision title, rationale, alternatives considered, stakeholders, and decision date

screens.name: Decision Detail
screens.purpose: Full view of a single decision showing all context, outcomes, and related decisions

screens.name: Search & Filter
screens.purpose: Allow users to find decisions by keyword, date range, or decision owner

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview showing recent decisions, decision trends, and quick stats

outOfScope: Integration with external tools (Slack, Jira, etc.)
Permission management and role-based access control
